description: Search EBI's MGnify metagenomics archive for studies by free-text query (name/abstract/bioproject) and/or biome lineage (e.g. "root:Host-associated:Human"). Returns each study's accession, name, abstract, bioproject, sequencing centre, sample count, last-update date, and associated biome lineages. Data: EMBL-EBI MGnify (www.ebi.ac.uk/metagenomics), no auth required.

biome_lineage.description: Filter to studies classified under this biome lineage, e.g. "root:Host-associated:Human" or "root:Environmental:Aquatic:Marine". Get valid lineages from ebi-metagenomics.biome_browse.

page_size.description: Number of studies to return per page, 1-25 (default 10).

query.description: Free-text search across study name, abstract, and bioproject, e.g. "gut microbiome".

name: ebi-metagenomics.studies.search

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Search MGnify Metagenomic Studies
